patch.summary:
Choose ClickFunnels only if your buying job matches “Funnel and landing-page platform for creators and marketers — a primary Kartra peer for al” rather than Livestorm's shape. Choose Livestorm only if your buying job matches “Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.” rather than ClickFunnels's shape. Workflow advantage: ClickFunnels leans funnel-building, landing-pages; Livestorm leans multichannel-campaigns, creator-marketing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: ClickFunnels is Funnel and landing-page platform for creators and marketers — a primary Kartra peer for all-in-one funnel stacks.; Livestorm is Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams..
- Company-size focus: ClickFunnels (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Livestorm (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: ClickFunnels-leaning funnel-building, landing-pages, marketing-automation vs Livestorm-leaning multichannel-campaigns, creator-marketing.
- Researched limits: ClickFunnels — No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch; Livestorm — Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder.

Limitations — ClickFunnels: No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch; All-in-one funnel breadth can be heavier than a dedicated ESP; Livestorm: Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder; Pro caps session length at 4 hours (12 on Enterprise).
